summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Advisory Agreement with Alexander Gurevich and an Intellectual Property License Agreement with BP United Inc. The advisory agreement grants 5 million restricted shares at $0.40 per share in exchange for strategic advisory services; the license agreement grants an exclusive perpetual worldwide license to certain IP. No board recommendation or advisor is named. These are routine material definitive agreements, not a special situation. There is no transaction with a target, acquirer, or strategic review; the filing is operational in nature. No risk-arb angle or structural change applies.
